manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Saw in Half
description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saw in Half, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Saw in Half, destroying Naru Meha and creating two token copies of it with half its toughness and power, rounded up each time.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
